State-level formulas used as PROPERTY or PROPERTIES are only checked in the initial state. To verify that the formula Prop2 holds in all states of every behavior, use INVARIANT Prop2 instead. Alternatively, applying the "always" temporal operator ([]) to the state-level formula Prop2 changes it into a temporal formula, asserting that Prop2 holds in all states of every behavior.
